episodes.title: Mothers and Daughters
episodes.summary: Kat and teen daughter Alice move in with estranged grandma Del. Escaping the tension, Alice explores the farm and finds herself on a surprising journey.

episodes.title: Scar Tissue
episodes.summary: Kat is presented with a book deal that asks her to dredge up terrible memories. Del wants to say goodbye to the past, while Alice yearns to return there.

episodes.title: I Don't Want to Miss a Thing
episodes.summary: Alice falls in love with the past and has her first kiss. Kat starts a job at the local paper. Del deals with bittersweet memories attached to Colton's boat.

episodes.title: What's My Age Again?
episodes.summary: Alice double dates with her parents as teens. Kat's first visit to the past brings a surprising discovery. Del swallows her pride to ask for help.

episodes.title: Don't Dream It's Over
episodes.summary: Kat chaperones a school dance and reconnects with Brady; Alice wants Nick to find her in the future; Del says goodbye to more memories as a landmark closes.

episodes.title: Building a Mystery
episodes.summary: Kat and Alice try to stop Jacob's disappearance; Del realizes the tragedy of Jacob was not hers alone.

episodes.title: The End of the World as We Know It
episodes.summary: Alice goes to a NYE Y2K party to support her friend. Kat finds a new mystery about her father, while Del reveals an old secret about him that's troubled her.

episodes.title: Lovefool
episodes.summary: When an old friend returns, Alice realizes her relationship has no future, while Kat is shocked by family secrets. Del tries to take a chance with Byron.

episodes.title: The Day the Music Died
episodes.summary: Alice says goodbye to the past, knowing she needs to make a life in the present. Kat tries to stop her father's death. Del revisits memories in a new light.

episodes.title: Not All Who Wander Are Lost
episodes.summary: Kat and Alice attend Colton's funeral. Del goes to the grief group and makes peace with her memory of Colton. Kat has a new theory about Jacob.

episodes.title: The Space Between
episodes.summary: Del recreates traditions of the past; Alice misses her friends; Kat grapples with Jacob's mystery in the wake of losing Elliot.

episodes.title: Hanging by a Moment
episodes.summary: Del considers the future of Landry Farm; Kat searches for answers through the past; Alice tries to make peace with Elliot.

episodes.title: When You Were Young
episodes.summary: The Landry women and Elliot reflect on what it means to grow up as they hang on to memories from their younger days while accepting who they have become.

episodes.title: Wake Me Up When September Ends
episodes.summary: Alice reevaluates the past and her friendship with Elliot, Kat discovers that history is told by the winners, Del questions the stories she tells herself.

episodes.title: Long Time Gone
episodes.summary: Founder's Day in Port Haven brings up memories for Del, Alice, and Elliot. Kat finds herself caught between two worlds in her search for answers.

episodes.title: How to Save a Life
episodes.summary: The Landry women reach an emotional climax as Kat works to conjure up a rescue, while Alice sees Del through a wave of grief as old wounds are opened.

episodes.title: Somewhere Only We Know
episodes.summary: The Landry women learn things aren't always as they seem as each uncovers new past and present truths. Elliot questions how much of Kat's heart is in 1814.

episodes.title: Lose Yourself
episodes.summary: Del, Kat, and Alice learn how events of the past have shaped their family's present. Alice learns a secret that affects her relationship with Elliot.

episodes.title: Here Without You
episodes.summary: All three Landry women feel the absence of a key ally in their lives as they struggle to make life-altering decisions and choices.

episodes.title: Bring Me to Life
episodes.summary: Del, Kat, Alice, and Elliot each receive answers about their past and present, while hope for the future brings new questions.

episodes.title: You Ain't Seen Nothing Yet
episodes.summary: New mysteries unfold across generations, as the Landry family looks to their past to find the truth

episodes.title: The Way We Were
episodes.summary: Each member of the Landry family meets challenges and new adventures as truths and shocking revelations come to light.

episodes.title: Live and Let Die
episodes.summary: Alice and Kat get a lesson in asking the right questions; Del rails against changes to the family dynamic; Elliot tries to understand his father.

episodes.title: I'll Have to Say I Love You in a Song
episodes.summary: Romance is top of mind as Alice, Kat, and Del reflect on love in their past, present, and future. Meanwhile, Jacob struggles with his memories.

episodes.title: Reeling In the Years
episodes.summary: Del celebrates a birthday, as the rest of the Landry family and Elliot take a step back to reassess their investigations.

episodes.title: Ain't No Sunshine
episodes.summary: Kat and Jacob uncover a dark moment in Port Haven's past. Elliot reckons with his past and fate. Alice worries about what her future might hold.

episodes.title: Tell Me Something Good
episodes.summary: The Landrys and Elliot reach difficult decisions and come to key realizations, as each sees that they may need to say goodbye to an aspect of their life.

episodes.title: Smoke on the Water
episodes.summary: The Landry family faces the facts of recent revelations, as they grapple with a past that they now know wasn't always as it seemed.

episodes.title: Too Late to Turn Back Now
episodes.summary: The Landry women pick up the pieces of their past, each wishing they could read Colton's mind. Jacob may have a secret he's keeping from them too.

episodes.title: If You Could Read My Mind
episodes.summary: The three Landry women finally get answers to questions about the past, present, & future. But a shocking discovery will propel them to search for more.

episodes.title: Show Me the Way to Go Home
episodes.summary: Alice is about to graduate high school. Kat and Elliot dream of the next steps for their relationship. Del realizes she will soon be an empty-nester again.

episodes.title: Blinded by the Light
episodes.summary: When Kat finds herself in a new era of Port Haven history, new mysteries unfold. Alice revisits a familiar time. Del tries to help Elliot.

episodes.title: Dust in the Wind
episodes.summary: Kat and Elliot plan a romantic getaway, while Alice tries to gather more clues. Del and Sam get a surprise visit from Elliot's father, Vic.

episodes.title: We've Got Tonight
episodes.summary: When Nick arrives back in Port Haven, Del throws a party like old times. Alice has to keep her distance from Young Colton and Del, but tries to learn more.

episodes.title: Don't Cry Out Loud
episodes.summary: When Nick joins Kat on her search for more information about Elliot's mother in the 1920s, the two realize they may be in over their heads.

episodes.title: Yes Sir, That's My Baby
episodes.summary: Elliot becomes engrossed with uncovering more of his mother's secret history and recruits Kat's help, while Jacob reacclimatizes to life in Port Haven.

episodes.title: Working My Way Back to You
episodes.summary: Some questions are answered for Elliot and Kat, while others linger. New choices arise for Alice as she evaluates her future.

episodes.title: Tainted Love
episodes.summary: As Kat works to piece together what lies ahead, Elliot tries to learn more about Tessa as he does his best to reconnect with his mom.

episodes.title: Auld Lang Syne
episodes.summary: New Year's Eve in 1925 brings into focus the Landry and Augustine families' destiny, and Elliot and Kat witness it. In another time, Alice does the same.

episodes.title: Ahead by a Century
episodes.summary: Across generations, endings and new beginnings arrive for the Landry family and their loved ones, as the pond always brings surprises.
